dedupe_keys.name: aneel collective continuity indicators dec and fec for brazilian electricity distribution limits results compensation and consumer set attributes

description: This data set from the Brazilian electricity regulator ANEEL gives the limits and the measured values of the collective continuity indicators DEC, the equivalent interruption duration per consumer unit in hours, and FEC, the equivalent interruption frequency per consumer unit, together with their disaggregated components. It also gives the number and value of compensations paid by distribution companies for breaching continuity limits, and the physical and electrical attributes of the consumer-unit sets over which the indicators are computed. The rules are those of Module 8 of the distribution procedures (PRODIST). Files are split by decade, 2000 to 2009, 2010 to 2019 and 2020 to 2029, with Parquet copies, plus limit and attribute tables and a PDF data dictionary for each part; the resources were refreshed on 5 September 2026. Coverage is Brazilian distribution companies by consumer-unit set. Files are free to download through the portal and its CKAN API under the Open Database License (ODbL). Caveats: indicators are reported by the distributors under ANEEL rules, and sets change over time, so long series need care. Simulation uses are reliability baselines and regulatory benchmarks for distribution resilience models. Related records: data-aneel-distribution-interruptions-brazil gives the underlying interruption events.
